published.protocol: Tmax = 2.4 n s, 10 seeds, all 100 X instances

note: 13 of the 100 X instances (every ~3rd by size, n = 100 to 1000), one seed, at 10% of the published time budget (0.24·n s instead of 2.4·n s), because the shared CPU allows ~5 cores across ten projects. Racing PyVRP and OR-Tools gives a mean gap to best-known of 0.47%; 2 instances hit the best-known solution exactly and 6 are within 0.5%. OR-Tools alone averages 9.74% and found no feasible plan within budget on 1 tight-capacity instance(s). Verdict rule: reached = within the published PyVRP gap; close = within about 2x of it or matching it at full budget on a subset; otherwise not reached.
short: 13 CVRPLIB X instances at 10% of the published time: the open-source race averages 0.47% from best-known (published state of the art at full time: 0.11–0.22%).
